After Dark Thursday Nights
Every Thursday Night • 6:00–10:00 pm

Stop scrolling and escape to reality at Pier 15! Get a little weird with us for evenings worth talking about. Rewire your own brain with our weekly explorations of science, art, and culture. Bring your full self and talk to strangers with art lounges, trivia nights, dance parties, surprising experiments, performances, demos, talks, and more. Maybe you’ll play like no one’s watching with 650+ hands-on exhibits. Maybe you’ll let the week go in the total darkness of the Tactile Dome. Grab a drink, try something new, and go home different.

Are you afraid of the dark?

Embrace your fears inside the world-famous Tactile Dome!

Immerse yourself in total darkness by walking, crawling, climbing, and sliding your way through this interactive sculpture—but there's even more lurking just around the corner. Explore the mystery textures and curious noises all around you, and take your Halloween to the next level with this thrilling yet not-too-scary experience.

Learn More →

* The special Halloween-inspired Tactile Dome experience is only available at After Dark (ages 18+). Reservations are required and advance tickets are strongly recommended. Tickets can be purchased in advance online or by phone for all sessions by calling 415.528.4444 (option 5). Tickets can also be purchased on site at the Ticketing and the Information Desk during open hours.
